players.product: Server PCBs (high-layer-count, high-speed boards for general-purpose and AI servers supporting Intel, AMD and Arm CPUs; PCIe 6.0 server PCBs in small-volume ramp), plus accelerator-card, optical-module and switch PCBs

quarterly_data.quarter: Delton Technology results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual (05-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Director and general manager Zeng Hong (2025 annual results briefing): in Q1 2026 products of 18 layers and above plus high-order HDI were about 28% of main-business revenue; orders on hand are ample with strong compute demand; PCIe 6.0 is expected to enter formal mass production after Q3 2026, while PCIe 7.0 applications are still in pre-research. Board secretary Zeng Yangqing said the company has done R&D and samples on M9-grade products but has no volume orders yet, and has started pre-research on optical-module PCBs. Chairman Xiao Hongxing said capacity utilization has stayed near full and the company keeps expanding through retrofits and new capacity.
quarterly_data.figure: 18-layer-plus and high-order HDI about 28% of Q1 2026 main-business revenue

quarterly_data.quarter: Delton Technology results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual (05-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Supply and pricing (2025 annual results briefing): chairman Xiao Hongxing said copper foil, resin and glass cloth - the raw materials of its CCL suppliers - rose sharply over the past half year on tight upstream supply, copper price rises and strong demand; the company has supply agreements that prioritise supply with prices negotiated to market, and keeps gross margin stable through yield gains, order-mix optimisation and price increases. General manager Zeng Hong said compute demand has made high-end PCB capacity tight, and with new capacity and rising unit prices from product upgrades the growth trend should continue; the chairman said he is confident results will keep growing in 2026.
